visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair and a green floral dress speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor home setting. A green potted plant hangs from the ceiling. She gestures with her hands while expressing her feelings about returning to the office. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a kitchen counter with various tea tins and bags. A pink tin, a gold tin, and silver tea bags are visible. A hand reaches into the frame to indicate the items. (3) The woman appears again, talking enthusiastically. Then, a black stainless steel thermos is shown. A hand demonstrates the removable tea infuser basket inside. (4) The woman holds a large white bag of Snak Yard Quail Eggs (Costco brand). She explains the need for low-sugar snacks to avoid weight gain. (5) She presents two product boxes: "TEA POWER" and "PLANT POWER" protein powders from the brand "Dancing Cha." The boxes feature cartoon illustrations of a cat and have various pastel colors. (6) Several close-up shots show different boxes and individual sachets of protein powder. Text overlays appear showing the nutritional content like protein and calorie counts. (7) She holds up more boxes, specifically mentioning flavors like Earl Grey Cocoa and Kale. She points to the ingredient list on the back of a pink box. (8) The woman stands in the kitchen holding two boxes of the protein powder, smiling and recommending the product for a healthy afternoon tea snack.
